title: Restart Remobilization Fee: Calculation for Professional Services Projects
content:
This is the calculation of the remobilization fee of a Professional Services Projects fixed-fee engagement resumed after a client-caused hold longer than the class hold limit.

## Definitions

1. **Restart change order.** The restart change order is the signed change order with the highest change order number on the engagement, provided it was registered on or after the resumed date; change orders are numbered in sequence as they are registered.
2. **Remobilization fee.** The remobilization fee of such a resumption is the class remobilization fee less the administration fees posted on the engagement's billing for the restart change order, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.
3. **Order of the amounts.** The remobilization fee before deduction is the class remobilization fee. Any scaling factors are multiplied together and applied once to the remobilization fee before deduction, any amounts added to the remobilization fee are added after that scaling, the administration fees posted for the restart change order are deducted last, the remobilization fee is never below zero, and it is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

| Step of the amount | Content |
|---|---|
| before deduction | the class remobilization fee |
| deduction, last | the administration fees posted on the engagement's billing for the restart change order |
| floor | zero |
| rounding | half up to the cent, at the end |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- Class remobilization fee 1000.00; administration fees of 312.50 posted for the restart change order: the remobilization fee is 687.50.
- Class remobilization fee 0.00; administration fees of 100.00 posted for the restart change order: the result would be below zero, so the remobilization fee is 0.00.
- If the highest-numbered signed change order was registered before the resumed date, there is no restart change order and no administration fee is deducted.
